zh.title: 2028年法恩伯勒航展預訂率達93%
zh.summary: 2028年法恩伯勒航展預訂率已達93%；主辦方增加展覽空間
body: 法恩伯勒國際航展（Farnborough International Airshow, FIA）主辦方透露，2028年活動的展覽與貴賓室空間已有93%被售出或預訂。
此次預訂需求使該航展有望在78年歷史上最早售罄。主辦方已增加1,900平方公尺的展覽空間，並考慮進一步擴展。
2028年法恩伯勒航展將於2028年7月17日至21日舉行，屆時將匯集全球領先的製造商、航空公司、國防承包商及航太技術公司。

en.title: Farnborough Airshow 2028 already 93% booked
en.summary: Farnborough Airshow 2028 reaches 93% booking rate; organizers add exhibition space
body: Organisers of the Farnborough International Airshow (FIA) have revealed that 93% of exhibition and chalet space for the 2028 event has already been sold or reserved.

The level of demand puts the UK airshow on course for the earliest sell-out in its 78-year history. Organisers have added another 1,900 square metres of exhibition space and are considering further expansion.
The next FIA is scheduled to take place from 17-21 July 2028, bringing together leading manufacturers, airlines, defence contractors and aerospace technology companies from around the world.

zh.title: NTSB發現阻燃劑腐蝕滅火飛機 籲美國林務局強化測試
zh.summary: NTSB調查發現滅火飛機遭阻燃劑腐蝕，籲美國林務局強化測試。
body: 國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）調查發現，滅火飛機使用的阻燃劑造成機體腐蝕。NTSB於2026年11月17日呼籲美國林務局強化測試要求。
Aero Air營運的MD-87曾參與林務局2023年的試驗。該機機翼主樑補強件受腐蝕，侵蝕深度超過補強件厚度的一半。
調查人員指出，林務局的核可程序未充分評估該化學品在實際操作條件下對飛機的影響。
相關阻燃劑Fortress FR-200由Fortress North America製造，已於2024年12月自林務局核可名單移除。

en.title: NTSB finds retardant corroded firefighting aircraft, urges stronger testing
en.summary: NTSB finds fire retardant corroded firefighting aircraft and urges stronger US Forest Service testing.
body: The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) found that fire retardant caused corrosion in firefighting aircraft. On November 17, 2026, it called for stronger US Forest Service testing requirements.
An MD-87 operated by Aero Air took part in a Forest Service trial in 2023. Corrosion penetrated more than half the thickness of a wing-spar doubler on that aircraft.
Investigators found that the Forest Service’s approval process had not adequately assessed how the chemical would affect aircraft under actual operating conditions.
Fortress FR-200, a retardant product made by Fortress North America, was removed from the Forest Service’s approved list in December 2024.
